description: Open a SPEND or WITHDRAW proposal on a joint account that needs more than one approval. This only creates the proposal; co-owners still approve and execute it in the Moneda app. For single-signature sub-accounts use propose_sub_account_withdraw or initiate_payment with source.kind=sub_account. Creates a request the user approves in the Moneda mobile app; nothing happens until then. After calling, poll get_payment_status.

accountId.description: SPEND only: one of the user's saved wallets

contactAccountId.description: SPEND only: contact wallet account ID

proposalType.description: SPEND pays a recipient; WITHDRAW returns to main

name: propose_sub_account_multisig_proposal
